Officer's narrative
Officers responded to an intersection in Pearland, Texas, where Driver 1 was turning left and was struck by Driver 2.
Driver 1 reported neck pain and said the impact felt like a whiplash injury. The reported injury fits the type and force of
this crash. Driver 2 and two independent witnesses gave accounts that match Driver 1's description of how the
collision happened, and scene photographs support those accounts. Passenger was in Driver 1's vehicle at the time,
as confirmed by witnesses and by officers at the scene. Most of the vehicle damage lines up with the impact
described. However, a review of prior records shows the same major damage to the same areas from an earlier
incident that was never reported to police or an insurer, and that damage is now being presented as part of this
collision. Driver 1 is a named driver on the policy. Further review of the earlier records is recommended before the
damage is assessed.
